V_kCAFG_populist_faction_creation_minimum_minority_factor = 0.3
V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor = V_kCAFG_smaller_minority_factor

# 25% at V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor - 125% at max culture
# Scope : county
V_kCAFG_populist_faction_faction_to_join_culture_factor = {
    value = 1
    every_in_list = {
        variable = kCAFG_county_cultures
        limit = {
            scope:faction.var:faction_culture = this
            save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture
            root = { V_kCAFG_county_culture_factor >= V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor }
        }
        save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture
        root = {
            value = 0.25
            add = {
                value = V_kCAFG_county_culture_factor
                subtract = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor
                min = 0
                divide = {
                    value = 1
                    subtract = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# 25% at V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor - 125% at max faith
# Scope : county
V_kCAFG_populist_faction_faction_to_join_faith_factor = {
    value = 1
    every_in_list = {
        variable = kCAFG_county_faiths
        limit = {
            scope:faction.var:faction_faith = this
            save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_faith
            root = { V_kCAFG_county_faith_factor >= V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor }
        }
        save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_faith
        root = {
            value = 0.25
            add = {
                value = V_kCAFG_county_faith_factor
                subtract = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor
                min = 0
                divide = {
                    value = 1
                    subtract = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_join_minimum_minority_factor
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

kCAFG_faction_county_opinion_astray_scaled_by_joined_faction_faith = {
	value = county_opinion
	multiply = -1.0
    multiply = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_faction_to_join_faith_factor
}
kCAFG_faction_county_opinion_hostile_scaled_by_joined_faction_faith = {
	value = county_opinion
	multiply = -2.5
    multiply = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_faction_to_join_faith_factor
}
kCAFG_faction_county_opinion_evil_scaled_by_joined_faction_faith = {
	value = county_opinion
	multiply = -5.0
    multiply = V_kCAFG_populist_faction_faction_to_join_faith_factor
}
